source-dispositions.notes: Two held AEMZ exposures are recovered through separate Sales captions. Select the lower original ND and rural images. Their processed top-card versions are duplicates. The railway group remains ambiguous. KTPTO has processing and suffix uncertainty. The concrete top-card appears reconstructed; its lower external etsol image has unproven Alageum provenance. A combined KTPN/KTPG/2KTPP card cannot identify separate families.

Evaluated all 65 catalog leaf links. Retain the MTPO pole photo cautiously as a type reference. The blue kiosk is reused across KTPG and KTPN cable/cable variants, including 1600 and 2500; its prefix is unresolved. A white cabinet is reused for rural KTP and KTPND. KTPTO, KTPS, MTPZh10 and (2)KTPG repeat frozen photographs. Drawings do not count.

A genuine photo shows a low mining-station skid. Power and climate version are not established. The seller’s own company history documents its Alageum group relationship. No thumbnail or crop counts as a second angle.

KTPZh 2–2500 cards repeat one rendered three-phase assembly, incompatible with the small single-phase 27.5 kV pole construction. ATP repeats a generic kiosk also used for PSK/KTPKO. MTPZh 1.25/2.5 repeats the frozen three-phase MTP photograph, which has the wrong phase construction.

RIN09440 is a real modular kiosk under a KTPB 35/110/220 card, but it does not show an outdoor HV switchyard. Its exact substation family is unproven. Cabinet images were passed to the separate switchgear review.
The 188-page PDF is byte-identical to the previously reviewed PwC Alageum catalog. All 54 extracted assets from substation pages 88–131 are drawings. Three contact sheets were visually checked.

NT-RT returned 502 for the PDF and timed out for the index. The elec.ru 2015 PDF returned 403. No restriction bypass or authenticated route was attempted. Other previously acquired KTZ catalogs cover these technical series.
The KTPZh400 image is render-like and has no site or plate evidence. The page does not identify Alageum or KTZ as the manufacturer. No assignment.
Alageum mentions refer to transformer product cards, not the assembled substations. They do not establish an Alageum station manufacturer. No assignment.

The 2015 presentation contains factory, transformer and switchgear collages without usable substation identities. Aktau visit pictures show people and the site rather than a completed concrete BKTP. The official KTPTO news photo shows an exhibition stand. The 117-page ETS tender includes a KTZ-signed KTPShG250 construction drawing, not a photograph.
